# Bill Jeferson Nababan

> Web developer in Batam, Indonesia. Backend-focused full stack: REST APIs in Node.js and Express, data in MySQL and PostgreSQL (some MongoDB), and React front ends. Studied Informatics Engineering at Batam State Polytechnic. Certified RHCSA (Red Hat, 2023) and Junior Web Programmer (BNSP, 2024).

This site is a single page. Each section below is an anchor on it.
